metadata.name: floor_hook
metadata.description: FLOOR on Solana: the FLOOR mechanism as an approved Carpenter hook

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not the required authority

errors.name: BadConfig
errors.msg: register_pool configuration is invalid

errors.name: NotLauncher
errors.msg: signer is not the launch authority

errors.name: MintAlreadyPooled
errors.msg: mint already has a pool

errors.name: NotAmmPool
errors.msg: callback signer is not this FloorPool's AMM pool

errors.name: NotInitializer
errors.msg: pool initializer is not the registered Launch

errors.name: NotBound
errors.msg: FloorPool is not bound to a pool

errors.name: WrongPool
errors.msg: pool account is not this FloorPool's AMM pool

errors.name: NotDynamicFee
errors.msg: FLOOR pools require the dynamic fee flag

errors.name: ExactOutNotSupported
errors.msg: FLOOR pools refuse exact-output swaps in this build

errors.name: SeedRangeFixed
errors.msg: the seed range is fixed by the first seed_liquidity

errors.name: BadRange
errors.msg: range is invalid or yields zero liquidity

errors.name: LadderAlreadySeeded
errors.msg: the ladder is already seeded

errors.name: RecipientPendingClaim
errors.msg: fee recipient is pending its claim

errors.name: WrongDestination
errors.msg: destination token account is not the configured one

errors.name: AlreadyResolved
errors.msg: recipient already resolved

errors.name: InvariantViolated
errors.msg: an invariant failed in an epilogue

errors.name: AmmReturnMissing
errors.msg: the AMM returned no or malformed HookOpResultV1

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: MinBidOutOfRange
errors.msg: min_bid is outside this quote's hard range

errors.name: BountyOutOfRange
errors.msg: the ratchet bounty rate or ceiling is outside its hard range

errors.name: NotSeeded
errors.msg: the pool is not open for trade until graduation has seeded it

errors.name: QuoteNotListed
errors.msg: the quote mint is not on the FLOOR roster (list_quote it first)

errors.name: QuoteAlreadyListed
errors.msg: the quote mint is already on the FLOOR roster

errors.name: QuoteRetired
errors.msg: the quote mint is retired: no new pool may be registered against it

errors.name: QuoteDecimalsOutOfRange
errors.msg: the quote mint decimals are outside the admissible window (no launch could ever price on it)

errors.name: QuoteNotAmmQuote
errors.msg: carpenter_amm does not list this mint as a quote mint

errors.name: NothingOwed
errors.msg: nothing is owed: pay_holder was asked to pay zero

errors.name: QuoteMintNotSupported
errors.msg: the quote mint is refused by the mint gate in the quote role (carpenter-mint-gate)

errors.name: QuoteCapsNotAdmitted
errors.msg: a capability of this quote mint is not admitted by carpenter_amm's quote_caps_admitted mask

errors.name: QuoteSuspended
errors.msg: the quote is suspended (its vault is frozen or its mint is paused): observe_quote must read it clear first

errors.name: TreasuryNotMigrated
errors.msg: the platform cut is paid only to the program-owned treasury

errors.name: TreasuryIsNotGovernance
errors.msg: the treasury cannot be its own governance: it can never sign a withdrawal

errors.name: TreasuryGovernanceIsAttestor
errors.msg: the treasury's governance may not be the launch program's attestor: one key, one role

errors.name: BadWithdrawal
errors.msg: a withdrawal moves a non-zero amount out of the treasury, never back into it

errors.name: NotTreasuryAccount
errors.msg: the withdrawal source is not a token account the platform treasury owns

errors.name: TreasuryBalanceShort
errors.msg: the withdrawal is larger than the treasury account's balance

errors.name: NotHoldersAuthority
errors.msg: pay_holder must be signed by floor_holders' holders_authority PDA

errors.name: HolderPayExceedsOwed
errors.msg: pay_holder: the amount exceeds what this pool owes its holders

errors.name: HolderRateNeedsHook
errors.msg: a holder rate needs FLOOR's empty transfer-hook slot on the base mint, and the slot needs a holder rate

errors.name: ReferrerNotAllowed
errors.msg: a referrer is allowed only when the fee recipient is the deployer's own wallet, and never the referrer itself

errors.name: BadReferralTier
errors.msg: claim_referral_fees: the tier must be 1, 2 or 3

errors.name: TeamFeeOutOfRange
errors.msg: the pool's FLOOR Platform fee is above its cap (TEAM_POOL_FEE_BPS_MAX)

errors.name: TwapUnavailable
errors.msg: twap_tick: this pool has no price oracle yet (no tail, or never written)

errors.name: TwapWindowTooLong
errors.msg: twap_tick: the window is longer than the oracle's oldest checkpoint

errors.name: BadQuoteToken
errors.msg: only a wSOL pool's platform cut feeds $FLOOR, and $FLOOR's pool is wSOL-quoted

errors.name: FloorPoolNotLive
errors.msg: $FLOOR's pool is not live yet: the wSOL cut stays owed on its pool until it graduates

errors.name: FloorPoolNotEligible
errors.msg: $FLOOR's pool: designation needs a fresh unbound pool, and it never credits itself

errors.name: SkimSellMultipleOutOfRange
errors.msg: register_pool: the at-floor sell multiple is outside 10,000..=50,000 bps (1x..=5x)

errors.name: SkimSellAtFloorAboveCap
errors.msg: register_pool: the at-floor sell skim (far x multiple) is above 1,500 bps (15 %)

errors.name: StairShapeOutOfRange
errors.msg: register_pool: the staircase is outside steps 1..=16, growth 5,000..=20,000 bps

errors.name: StairStateMissing
errors.msg: the staircase's StairState account is missing or wrong

errors.name: StairNotTokenOnly
errors.msg: the staircase: a step would not be token-only at the market

errors.name: GenesisStairRefused
errors.msg: set_genesis_stair: only $FLOOR's designated pool, once, before it is bound or seeded

errors.name: StairOwnerBadConfig
errors.msg: the owner steps: the config is outside its allowed range, or already written

errors.name: StairPayeePending
errors.msg: the owner steps: the payee's handle is not claimed yet

errors.name: StairWrongPayee
errors.msg: the owner steps: only the payee, to its own account

errors.name: StairStepLocked
errors.msg: the owner steps: this step is still locked

errors.name: StairStepNotAbove
errors.msg: the owner steps: only a step wholly above the price, after the ratchet

errors.name: StairPayeeResolved
errors.msg: the owner steps: the payee is already resolved

errors.name: HookGovernanceIsAttestor
errors.msg: the hook's governance can never be the attestor

errors.name: HookGovernanceCannotSign
errors.msg: the hook's governance must be a key that can sign

errors.name: StairArrayHot
errors.msg: the staircase rent reserve: that tick array is next to the price

errors.name: OwnerBooksExceedHoldings
errors.msg: the owner steps: the books claim more than the position holds

errors.name: QuoteNotAdmitted
errors.msg: the quote is not admitted: no QuotePolicy, no qualifying FLOOR parent, and allow-all is off

errors.name: DerivedQuoteTerms
errors.msg: a derived quote's terms are the hook's own: min_bid = 0.001 whole token rounded up, max_bounty = 0

errors.name: QuoteIsFloorLaunch
errors.msg: a FLOOR launch's token is never a listed quote: it is admitted by lineage and priced through its pools

errors.name: TraderNotLinked
errors.msg: trader referrals: the trader has no TraderLink (link first)

errors.name: TraderBucketOpen
errors.msg: trader referrals: that bucket is already open

errors.name: TraderRefBadAccount
errors.msg: trader referrals: an account is not the bucket, vault, payee or TraderBucket it must be

errors.name: BadRecipients
errors.msg: bad recipient slots: up to 5, each an address or a pending handle id, shares summing to 10,000

errors.name: BadSlot
errors.msg: no such slot
